real_candidate_rule: all source classes except 2/7/9, actual z minus median8NN observed class2 ground in [2,100]m; no teacher roof labeling or Z correction

geometric_region_definitions.inside_exact_footprint: Original immutable teacher roof-projection polygon covers XY, including its exact boundary; no XY shift/tolerance used.
geometric_region_definitions.outside_exact_within_5m_buffer: Outside original exact polygon but covered by its original Shapely buffer(5), no fitting or correction.
geometric_region_definitions.outside_5m_buffer: Outside that 5m polygon buffer; expected zero from frozen preparation.
geometric_region_definitions.outside_own_inside_another_selected20_pr: Outside own polygon and within another of the fixed20 source-train teacher roof-projection polygons. Lower bound: unselected neighboring buildings are not tested.

synthetic_native_xy.scope: Replay only the same20 frozen Leiden source-train teachers, all12 frozen cases and case-index variants. Main calibration/validation/test arrays, labels, catalogs and geometry were not opened.
synthetic_native_xy.code_evidence: prepare_data.samples draws barycentric XY on teacher roof triangles. observed obtains both roof and synthetic contaminants from samples; contamination/noise changes Z only; native observed XYZ is returned at tuple index5. No 5m neighboring-building pool is admitted.
synthetic_native_xy.native_vs_augmentation: train.strong_view separately adds 0.02m XY standard-deviation feature noise for configurations that call it. This does not modify stored native observed XYZ and does not provide a 5m neighbor-building support pool.

interpretation_boundaries: This establishes an input-support domain risk, not a single-factor causal explanation of score/mask differences.
Official AHN5 class6 is roof production classification, not independent human local GT; class1 is heterogeneous other, not tree GT.
The previous6729 class6 removed records include outside-own-footprint context; they cannot all be called removals of this building roof.
Even inside-own class6 disagreement is a diagnostic, not a verified local error rate; polygons and teacher share AHN upstream.
Neighbor overlap is measured only against the other19 fixed selected source-train priors; it is a lower bound and not an independently surveyed neighbor label.

Other possible domain differences remain: real density/noise/occlusion, observed scalar ground versus teacher ground, variable building-buffer context, and three512-point partition means versus main controlled single512 input.
No local threshold tuning, model selection, GPU forward, XYZ correction, data modification or main val/test access occurred.
